description: Calculate the short perpetual futures position size needed to hedge a spot holding. Default USDT-linear: sizes and costs in USD. With contractType "inverse" (coin-margined, needs entryPrice) the short is the same USD contracts and margin and funding come back in the base coin. Use when user asks "how much should I short to hedge my BTC?" or "what margin do I need for a 100% hedge?". Returns: perpNotional, requiredMargin, dailyFundingCost, annualFundingCost, hedgeCoverage, contractType and costUnit ("USD", or "base_coin" for inverse: read it before showing margin or funding as dollars). Inverse converts at the one entryPrice you give, so the coin figures assume the price stays there.

contractType.description: linear = USDT-margined (default). inverse = coin-margined: spotSize stays the USD value of the holding, requiredMargin and the funding costs are returned in the base coin.

entryPrice.description: Coin price in USD. Required for contractType inverse (converts the USD margin and funding to coin); ignored for linear.

fundingRatePct.description: Current funding rate per funding interval as a percentage, e.g. 0.01 (per 8h unless intervalHours says otherwise). Used for cost estimate.

hedgeRatio.description: Percentage of spot to hedge, e.g. 100 for full hedge, 50 for half. Default 100.

intervalHours.description: Hours between funding payments, the period fundingRatePct covers. Default 8 (3 payments a day); 1 on Hyperliquid, dYdX, Kraken and Backpack (per-hour rates); 4 or 2 on some symbols of Binance, Bybit, OKX, Gate, KuCoin, MEXC, Aster and Phemex.

leverage.description: Leverage on the perp short. Default 1.

name: primitive.hedge_ratio
title: Hedge Ratio
